F1: The matcher reads `substring(3, 5)` instead of the grant at `[4, 6)`, and its check is inverted, so in practice it accepts IDs with any grant and the integration tests never really check the grant.
F2: The test does pass because of an NPE, but production decoding correctly throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown shortcuts, so this is test-tightening on a path that already works.
F3: The interface docs suggest 3-letter shortcuts, but the decoder needs exactly 2 grant characters, so tokens from a custom grant with a 3-letter shortcut are issued and then always fail to decode.
F4: Line 73 null-checks `grantType` a second time instead of `rawTokenId`, so the intended invariant is never enforced and a null ID silently encodes as `...:null`.
